---
title: "Data and interfaces"
---

Transfer inputs traceably. The tool provides interfaces for energy performance certificates, weather, hourly PV generation and component data. Exact import fields and units depend on the tool version.

## Energy performance certificate

Transfer building and envelope properties from project documents. Align reference areas, uses, component areas and units with the certificate. Aggregating multiple buildings requires documented consolidation; sums and specific indicators are not interchangeable.

**Workflow:** Record source and version → align reference areas → transfer intended properties → check envelope and demand plausibility → save variant.

## Weather {#wetter}

The dataset must match the location and study objective. The training names Helios-PC as a data source; the repository contains additional weather files. In future-weather comparisons, document assessment requirements separately.

**Where in PEExcel?** [🌦]{.excel-menu .darkred} **Wetter** stores data; [🏙]{.excel-menu .darkred} **Quartier** selects the dataset.

**Workflow:** Record location and weather year → check hourly sequence and completeness → transfer into the intended weather area → check the calculation. Keep weather unchanged when isolating a system measure.

[PV inputs](pv.qmd) explains roof-area scaling and detailed hourly profiles. [LCA](climate.qmd#eco2soft) explains the Eco2soft connection, including CSV import.

## Excel ↔ Python

`Project.from_excel` loads saved exports. Schema and export version must agree. Annual results and hourly exports are distinct data sources. The [Python tutorial](python.qmd) uses existing import and reporting functions.

## Data for concept comparison and validation {#use-case-daten}

| Dataset | Required information | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| District | Location, floor areas by use, geometry, new/refurbished shares | Model boundary and reference quantities |
| Building and operation | Envelope, use profiles, temperature setpoints, heating, cooling, hot water and ventilation | Demand and thermal flexibility |
| Generation and storage | PV capacity/profile, battery capacity/power, efficiencies, thermal storage | Supply and storage operation |
| Mobility | Uses, travel assumptions, EV share, vehicles, charging points and power | Travel demand, presence and charging |
| Validation time series | Measured consumption, generation, imports, exports and storage states; timestamps and units | Compare model with observed operation |
| Additional grid study | Connection capacity, topology, transformer and line data | Transfer to an additional grid model |

For each input, record source, period and status: measured, planned or assumed. Time series need a common calendar, an agreed time zone and documented gap treatment. Aggregate finer measurements for hourly comparison while preserving short-term peaks as separate information.
